sehemu: Part III: The Prime Minister, the Cabinet and the Government
maudhui: (1) Without prejudice to the provisions of this Constitution, the Prime Minister shall be accountable to the President for the exercise of his authority. (2) The Government of the United Republic, under the authority of the President, shall be the organ having the power to determine the policy of the Government in general, and Ministers, under the leadership of the Prime Minister, shall be collectively responsible in the National Assembly for the execution of the affairs of the Government of the United Republic.
